What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged and ‘−’ and ‘×’ are interchanged?

536 + 67 × 9 − 22 ÷ 283 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dac1cf4bb2ed83077b1b0b3b3da6063ad091bd620d93a36703c8f9e358ac7b5.png] 

**Signs Interchange:**

 
 

 **Original Sign**
 +
 ÷
 −
 ×
 
 

 **New Sign**
 ÷
 +
 ×
 −
 
 

 

**Given Equation:**

536 + 67 × 9 − 22 ÷ 283

After **interchanging the signs** as per the rules (+ with ÷ and − with ×), the equation becomes:

= __**536 ÷ 67**__ − 9 × 22 + 283

= 8 - __**9 × 22**__ + 283

= __**8**__ - 198 __**+ 283**__

= __**291 - 198**__

= **93**

Therefore, the value that will come in place of the question mark is **93**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:
B, C, D, E, G, H and I are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between C and D, when counted from the left of D. G sits third to the left of I. B sits to the immediate right of I. B sits second to the left of C. H is not an immediate neighbor of G.

Who sits third to the right of E?
questions.solution:
1. Since all persons face the centre: **Right = counter-clockwise** and **Left = clockwise**. Fix **I** at position 1. **B** sits to the immediate right of **I** (counter-clockwise): **I(1) → B(2)**. Also, **B** sits second to the left of **C**, which means **C** is two places counter-clockwise from **B** (or **B** is two places clockwise from **C**): **C(4) → pos(3) → B(2)**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2f307265969d1c70076db628b1b9443f89d051f77fc21a5fd7544181480be77.png] 
2. **G** sits third to the left of **I** (clockwise direction): **I(1) → pos(7) → pos(6) → G(5)**. So **G** is at position 5.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/539e337e8b2f71887748e50dd780384b609782fc710fb1b7e2318a863a28d658.png] 
3. Two people sit between **C** and **D** when counted from the left of **D** (clockwise): **D → skip 2 → C(4)**. If **D** is at position 7, skipping pos 6 and pos 5 leads to **C** at position 4. So **D** is at position 7.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3863fc2be8e8b6b3d057549cc71cec0e9b8a0be6f0932b0c14084bd78071836.png] 
4. **H** is not an immediate neighbor of **G** (pos 5). Neighbors of **G** are positions 4 and 6. Thus, **H** cannot be at pos 6. The only available seat for **H** is position 3. The remaining person **E** must be at position 6.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fc7062f36643cbaf56a736f7bffb9227bb71ed7eae2d25213e38928d506b021.png] 

To find who sits third to the right of **E**, count three places in the counter-clockwise direction from **E**: **E(6) → D(7) → I(1) → B(2)**. Therefore, **B** sits third to the right of **E**.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 2'**.
